topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I wandered through the yard sale, the morning sun a gentle hum in the background, when I spotted a familiar face amidst the clutter. There, sitting on a faded blanket, was my teddy bear. I approached, my steps light as the breeze. His once-bright fur was dulled, but his eyes, oh, they still held a spark. Picking him up, I was struck by the warmth that seemed to radiate from him, as if he too remembered.holding him, the world narrowed to the soft whispers of the past and the rustle of leaves in the air. I didn’t know how long I stood there, but when I finally looked up, the sky seemed just a little bluer, the day a little brighter.
